title: AgentSwap
tagline: An AI-powered autonomous agent using AgentKit to execute DeFi actions like swaps, lending, staking, and yield farming. Integrated with the CDP SDK for seamless onchain interactions, it optimizes strategies and automates portfolio management in real time
description: AI-powered autonomous agent that leverages AgentKit to seamlessly interact with DeFi protocols. Using the CDP SDK, it can execute swaps, provide liquidity, stake tokens, lend assets, and optimize yield farming strategies—fully onchain. Designed for hands-free DeFi management, the agent can automate the portfolio with a simple message like 'automate my portfolio"
how_its_made:
Tech Stack & Architecture
	•	AgentKit: Core framework enabling AI-driven onchain interactions. It provides seamless access to crypto wallets and smart contracts.
	•	CDP SDK: Handles contract deployments, token swaps, transfers, lending, staking.
	•	React: Frontend interface for user interaction and strategy customization.
